fields.name: code
fields.description: A value that the server copies into the reply as `code`. The handler accepts a `null` payload; then `code` is `null`.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: Always. The handler needs no character.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Your `code`. Absent from the JSON when you sent none.

fields.name: list
fields.description: The most recent PvP kills on this server since it started, newest first: `[attacker, victim]` pairs, up to 200.

confirm.note: No character check. `code` is `null` (present) for a `null` payload, absent for a payload without `code`
